parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const fail=(statusCode,error)=>[{json:{ok:false,statusCode,error}}];const a=$json.headers?.authorization??'';if(!a.startsWith('Bearer '))return fail(401,'Sesión requerida.');try{const[h,p,s,x]=a.slice(7).trim().split('.'),secret=$env.JWT_SECRET;if(!secret||!h||!p||!s||x)throw new Error();const expected=crypto.createHmac('sha256',secret).update(`${h}.${p}`).digest('base64url'),l=Buffer.from(s),r=Buffer.from(expected);if(l.length!==r.length||!crypto.timingSafeEqual(l,r))throw new Error();const payload=JSON.parse(Buffer.from(p,'base64url').toString('utf8'));if(!payload.exp||payload.exp<=Date.now()/1000)throw new Error();const role=String(payload.rol??'').toUpperCase(),perms=(payload.permisos??[]).map(v=>String(v).toLowerCase());if(role!=='ADMINISTRADOR_PARKING'&&!perms.includes('parqueadero.ver')&&!perms.includes('parqueadero.gestionar'))return fail(403,'No tiene permisos.');return[{json:{ok:true}}];}catch{return fail(401,'La sesión es inválida o ha vencido.');}

SELECT pa.id::int AS "id", ('YV-' || LPAD(pa.id::text,6,'0')) AS "code", pa.parqueadero_usuario_id::int AS "parkingUserId", pa.pago_id::int AS "paymentId", COALESCE(v.id,0)::int AS "vehicleId", pm.modalidad AS "modality", pa.fecha_inicio::text AS "startDate", pa.fecha_fin::text AS "endDate", pa.estado AS "status", pa.creado_en::text AS "createdAt"
FROM public.parqueadero_autorizaciones pa
JOIN public.parqueadero_pagos pp ON pp.id=pa.pago_id
JOIN public.parqueadero_modalidades pm ON pm.id=pp.modalidad_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT pv.id FROM public.parqueadero_vehiculos pv WHERE pv.parqueadero_usuario_id=pa.parqueadero_usuario_id AND pv.activo=TRUE ORDER BY pv.es_principal DESC,pv.id LIMIT 1) v ON TRUE
ORDER BY pa.creado_en DESC,pa.id DESC;
